notes:
Summary: Silkbridge is a code search platform used internally by large enterprise engineering teams. They're evaluating Redwood for a RAG-style code search + reranking pipeline. Primary concerns: indexing scale (tens of millions of functions), query tail latency for reranker, and predictable cost per query.

Key requirements (from calls):
- Corpus: ~120M small artifacts (functions, snippets), ~18M canonical functions, ~600GB compressed indexed content. Expect heavy churn: 5-10% of corpus re-indexed daily across active repos.
- Query profile: 10k qps average across global pods during business hours; peak bursts up to 1.2k QPS per region for internal developer search. Real-time freshness important for CI-triggered indexing.
- Latency SLOs: vector lookup + ANN < 40ms, cross-encoder rerank (top10) p95 < 120ms, p99 target < 180ms.
- Cost target: total cost-per-interaction (ANN + rerank) < $0.0035, ideally ~$0.0025 at scale.
- Models: prefer dense embeddings (1536 dim) + a distilled cross-encoder for rerank. Open to Redwood-recommended quantized variants; want ability to pin versions.
- Routing/fallback: must fallback to smaller cheaper embedder during capacity events; deterministic routing by team/region.
- Security: enterprise SSO via SAML (Okta), audit logs, KMS integration for keys, retention controls and optional on-prem data residency.

POC notes:
- 2026-02-11 kickoff call (ff_20260211_4b3f9a). AE presented Redwood Dedicated + Private options.
- 2026-02-18 benchmark: ran 2.5M-file sample with Redwood hosted POC. ANN latency median 28ms, top10 rerank p95 95ms (on c5xlarge sim cluster). Cost estimate extrapolated to full corpus: ~$0.0038/query (current config) -> need Optimize suggestions to hit target.
- 2026-02-26 security sync: provided SOC2 + KMS doc; customer asks for HSM option and audit-log retention to 7 years.
- 2026-03-04 infra deep-dive with platform team: discussed incremental reindex stream (CDC) vs nightly batch; Silkbridge leans to hybrid (nearline for hot repos).

Quotes/snippets from stakeholders:
- "We need sub-150ms p99 for reranker or engineers won't switch from grep+local index." — Senior Engineer (search infra)
- "If we can't reindex hot repos within 15 minutes of commit, this won't work for CI-driven code search." — Head of DevTools

Open technical decisions to resolve:
- Deployment: Dedicated GPU pool in private VPC vs on-prem cluster packaging for air-gapped customers. They want a validated on-prem installer image.
- Reindexing: real-time streaming ingestion (CDC) feasibility and cost impact vs nightly micro-batches. Need auto-throttling policy from Redwood.
- Reranker placement: colocate cross-encoder on same GPU pool vs CPU-only scaled out separate service (tradeoff: latency vs cost).

Suggested Redwood playbook for next call:
- Provide a cost-sensitivity matrix (QPS vs cost-per-query) with Optimize recommendations (batching, quantization profiles) for Silkbridge's actual sample traces.
- Deliver SAML test plan and sample IdP metadata template.
- Produce an incremental-reindex architecture doc showing CDC pipeline + backpressure handling and expected indexing throughput (docs/sec).
